scope: 20 manually specified trusted synthetic stdlib Go cases; not a real model or real-world benchmark

cases.source:
package fixture
func Divide(a,b int) int { return a * b }
cases.reference: Integer division for nonzero denominator; independently specified positive and signed examples.

cases.reference: Select larger integer, including equal and negative values.

cases.reference: Absolute value for small integers; minimum representable integer excluded.

cases.source:
package fixture
func Sum(v []int) int {s:=0;for i:=0;i<len(v)-1;i++ {s+=v[i]};return s}
cases.reference: Sum includes last element; empty identity is zero.

package fixture
func Factorial(n int) int {out := 0;for i:=2;i<=n;i++ {out*=i};return out}
cases.reference: Factorial over domain 0..10; multiplication identity one.
Containment is not prefix matching; empty substring is contained.

cases.reference: Reverse rune sequence, preserving every code point.
